 Local News Schools Sponsored What's Happening Pitt-Titusville Offering FAFSA Completion Nights
 Pitt-Titusville and local school counselors will host a free FAFSA Completion Night on November 4, helping families complete financial aid applications with assistance from financial aid staff. Participants are encouraged to bring tax documents, FSA login information, and other required materials.
 Elicia Kifer
 Published October 20, 2026 9:00 am Pitt Titusville
 TITUSVILLE, Pa.  (EYT) – The University of Pittsburgh at Titusville Financial Aid staff, in conjunction with other area counselors, will offer a free FAFSA completion workshop. 
 On November 4, 2026, the Financial Aid staff, along with counselors from the high school, will offer a FAFSA completion night from 5:30 p.m. to 7:00 p.m. at the Titusville High School Library Computer Lab, 302 E. Walnut Street.
 Sessions will enable families to complete the FAFSA online with assistance from staff. Those interested should bring their 2025 federal tax return and related W-2 forms.
 Families should also bring both student and parent FSA usernames and passwords, along with investment statements for assets other than retirement accounts.
 Both the student and parent must be present to complete their portions of the FAFSA.
 For more information, contact the Guidance Office at 814-827-2715, ext. 1425.
